execution.training_track_sampling: StochasticTrack-v1 samples a stochastic track on every training reset from the seeded environment RNG; Development tracks 2000-2008 are evaluation-only and are not a finite training-track schedule.

paired_energy.conclusion: No jointly feasible seed-track pair; paired energy cannot be compared.

constrained_v2.caveat: Constrained V2 uses FSRL SACLag, different networks, replay, update rate, objective and explicit costs; its numerical outcome is therefore contextual, not a reward-only comparison.

paired_energy.conclusion: Coverage is too small to establish energy superiority.

scalar_sb3_sac.caveat: The scalar study also recorded separate milestone evaluations; this comparison uses only its deterministic 300k final policies. Those evaluation transitions did not enter replay.

paired_energy.conclusion: No jointly feasible seed-track pair; paired energy cannot be compared.

interpretation.acceptance: No separate preregistered final robustness threshold exists for this study; exact outcomes are reported without inventing one.
interpretation.efficiency: Only one LLM-reward episode was feasible. It had no jointly feasible pair with the primary scalar baseline; energy competitiveness cannot be established.
interpretation.search_scope: This is one LLM reward search followed by three policy-training replicates, not three independent reward searches.
interpretation.seed_robustness: Useful behavior did not replicate beyond the screening seed: seeds 29 and 47 completed 0/9 routes and achieved 0/9 RSR.
interpretation.task_acquisition: The frozen reward produced feasible driving once on seed 11 (1/9), so task acquisition occurred but was sparse.

per_seed_results.screening_role: used as the fixed candidate-screening training seed
